  "required_fixes": [
    "C23-R4-F1 (medium): Validate the new saved-document recovery bindings before they authorize publication or cleanup. PersistedState::is_consistent (store.rs:224 onward) does not inspect open_imports. load_v1_receipts (authority/import_v1_domain.rs:317-328) then merges its entries directly into the authoritative receipt inventory, and recover (:1621-1641) automatically rolls them back. This bypasses receipt::load's schema/ID checks (import_v1/receipt.rs:335-346). A structurally valid saved document containing an unsupported receipt.schema is accepted; with its receipt files unavailable, that unsupported record is adopted, written back and used for owner rollback. A terminal receipt placed in open_imports is likewise accepted, despite this field's unsettled-only invariant, and can bypass staging. Validate the receipt schema/identity and open-binding invariants before merging, publishing or reverting it; unsupported/inconsistent bindings must fail closed. Acceptance: seed a normal interrupted import, make both receipt files unavailable and change the document copy to an unsupported schema or an invalid terminal binding. Relaunch through the production storage/core path: report corrupt/unsupported recovery metadata, preserve owner stores, and perform neither automatic cleanup nor publication based on that invalid binding. Valid current bindings must retain the demonstrated recovery behavior."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "Independent read-only review. No application/source changes, build/test reruns, application launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. The remaining finding follows inspected serialization, consistency checks and recovery control flow; it is not claimed as a newly executed runtime reproduction. Only the designated verdict artifact is written.",
    "All four supplied fingerprints independently match at the beginning and end. Verified 730 source-inventory entries, 397 direct packet references, recorded command logs/artifacts, shared dependency equivalence and exact C23 command plans. Both direct predecessors pass at 9/10; 30 transitive receipt bindings match. Eleven source entries changed since attempt-03. This verdict assesses C23 on the integrated C23/C24 remediation tree.",
    "Attempt-03's required fixes and evidence gaps are addressed. Confirmed write-ahead open_imports copies retain the identities of unsettled writes when both receipt files are lost. Missing and unreadable directories are distinguished and entry-listing errors propagate. The expanded production-interface tests verify hidden/unselectable staged tenants during failed double-fault recovery and successful retry. Current native evidence covers the new lost-record alert, keyboard removal and focus restoration; all affected regression records now name the submitted executable. The focused commit binding is an appropriate architectural seam; the remaining issue is validation at its persisted-input boundary.",
    "Recorded evidence passes 13 check commands, 13 test/setup commands and 3 native-preparation commands. Logs include 421 desktop frontend tests, 221 core unit tests, 22 imports_rollback tests, 8 import-module tests, targeted owner regressions and 165 targeted frontend tests. All 9 C23 native checks and 250 C01-C22 regression checks report pass against executable 1a0665d8e53b91deb77e8bb7dc3dc523ee230815b050e46b5103934526f9ed08.",
    "Verified records for 44 named C23 mutation guards with current input hashes and four baseline targets passing three times each. The re-anchored C12 mutation's input hashes also match the current tree. These results support the remediated paths but do not cover unsupported/inconsistent open_imports entries. Category owners, source parsing/planning and conditional offline-store code remain unchanged from the previously inspected versions, preserving the account and draft-race fixes.",
    "The follow-up notes disclose a C20 native failure whose request log was overwritten on retry; its proposed random-PKCE false-positive cause cannot be independently confirmed. Inspected the replacement signed-token pattern and retained literal secret/canary checks; the current source-bound C20 record passes. No historical failure is relabeled as confirmed harmless.",
    "V1 data and Keychain items are synthetic fixtures. Real v1 profiles and production login-Keychain reads remain C25 qualification. Interruption hooks model process stops rather than physical power loss. No C23 workload is registered; its explicit import bounds remain the applicable performance scope. Spoken VoiceOver and signed installed-package qualification are not established by this chunk."
  ],
